ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

appearances.note: Combine appearance and color to set the visual weight and the semantic meaning of the badge.

count.note: Counts above max render as "{max}+" with the full value in the title tooltip. Zero hides the badge unless showZero is set.

badge.description: Non-interactive badge component for status, labels, and counts.

dot.note: Dots signal presence or unread state without a number. Pulse adds a live ring and respects reduced motion.

examples.note: Start with the default badge, then explore appearances and variants below.

icons.note: Icons scale with the badge size. Icon-only badges need an accessible label.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris package, then import the component.

placement.note: Placed badges anchor to the corner of a positioned ancestor — wrap the target in position: relative.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

size-density.note: Size and density work together in the component. Combine both controls to see every combination.
